comment: Crossed-truth planet (D039). Identical to graded_floor_v3 in every respect -- same planted per-aquifer groundwater trends, same seed, same seasonal terms, same 1-cell edge taper, same accepted noise parameters -- EXCEPT that the background hydrology is built from ERA5-Land instead of GLDAS-2.1 Noah. Purpose: the analysis subtracts a GLDAS-Noah auxiliary, which on a GLDAS-built planet is an inverse crime with identically zero error. With an ERA5-Land background the subtraction error is a real inter-model discrepancy, so the recovered groundwater sign can be scored against the planted truth. Scoring subtracts BOTH auxiliaries: GLDAS-Noah (wrong model + unfiltered) and ERA5-Land (right model, still unfiltered), which separates auxiliary model error from the filter/attenuation mismatch.
